context: Tests /release-notes 1.1.0 against the tag v1.0.0. restore_history.py is environment setup: the .git folder, the docs/ files, the seven commits, and the tag it creates, and the removal of history/, are not changes by the agent. At v1.0.0 (2026-09-14): UC-001 Manage Workshops, UC-002 Register for Workshop, and UC-005 Print Attendance Sheet are Done, UC-003 List Participants is Tested, UC-004 Cancel Registration is Approved, UC-006 does not exist; FR-004 (cancel a registration) is not Verified. Since then: UC-001's file was renamed to UC-001-plan-workshops.md with only a comma added (no difference to the actor; a path-based match would wrongly see a new use case); UC-002 changed its registration deadline from 24 to 12 hours before the workshop starts and is Done again; UC-003 reached Done; UC-004 is Tested, not Done; UC-005 is Obsolete; UC-006 Export Participant List is new and Done, realizing the same FR-005 as UC-005; FR-006 (waiting list) was added as Deferred. One commit message claims 'participants can cancel their bookings online and join a waiting list when a workshop is fully booked' — the specifications say neither is available to users, and 'Booking' is in the glossary's Avoid column. Expected notes: New UC-003 and UC-006; Changed UC-002; Removed UC-005; Requirements delivered FR-003 only (its only use case UC-003 went from Tested to Done; FR-004 is Verified but not delivered, because UC-004 is only Tested; FR-001, FR-002, NFR-001, and FR-005 were already delivered at the tag — FR-005 is now realized by UC-006 alone, as UC-005 is Obsolete; FR-006 is Deferred). The product owner confirmed in advance whatever the agent proposes. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.
